title: Films, music, sport & free time
goal: Recommend and review films, series and songs, follow a cricket or football match with friends, talk about your hobbies, and compare things in depth: better than, not as good as, one of the best, the more… the more.
intro:
What do friends actually talk about? Last night's match, the new Nepali film everyone's arguing about, the song stuck in your head, what you do on a Saturday. This unit gives you the words to join in — and to have opinions.

Opinions mean **comparing**. You already know **भन्दा** 'than' and **सबैभन्दा** 'the most' (unit 8). Here you'll go further: 'not as good as' (**जत्तिको … छैन**), 'rather than going out, let's…' (**जानुभन्दा बरु…**), 'one of the best' (**सबैभन्दा राम्रोमध्ये एक**), 'better and better' (**झन्-झन्**) and 'the more you listen, the more you like it' (**जति … उति**).

vocab.note: Spelled फिल्म, usually said philim. Formal: चलचित्र (chalachitra).
Fans also say हिरो / हिरोइन for the leads.
verb-न + लायक "worth …-ing": खानलायक "worth eating", घुम्नलायक ठाउँ "a place worth visiting".
Very informal, used by young people: दामी छ! "it's great!". Don't use it in a job interview.
बेकार फिल्म "a terrible film"; बेकार हो "there's no point".
Folk song: लोकगीत; the sung duets of the hills: दोहोरी.
Female: गायिका (gāyikā).
गीत गाउनु "to sing a song"; गाउँछु, गायो.
In speech also म्युजिक.
X-नुभन्दा बरु Y "rather than X, Y".
Opposite: बलियो (baliyo) "strong".
From खेल्नु "to play".
म्याच हेर्नु "to watch a match".
X को फ्यान "a fan of X". Also: a ceiling fan.
Joined to the noun: खेलाडीमध्ये "among the players".
झन्-झन् "more and more". Close to अझ, but झन् stresses that something is growing.
गोल गर्नु / गोल हान्नु "to score".
Takes ले in the past: नेपालले जित्यो. "To beat X" is also X-लाई हराउनु.
बराबरीमा सकियो "ended in a draw".
मलाई … गर्ने सोख छ "I'm really into …ing".
नाच "a dance".

vocab.en: to play (an instrument); to ring, sound
vocab.note: गितार बजाउनु "to play guitar", but खेल खेल्नु "to play a game".
The traditional Nepali lute is the मादल (drum) and सारङ्गी (fiddle).
Answers जति in "the more…, the more…": जति … उति.

grammar.title: Comparing in depth: भन्दा, जत्तिकै, जत्तिको … छैन, बरु
grammar.body:
You know the basic pattern from unit 8: **X Y-भन्दा [adjective] छ** 'X is more [adj] than Y'. Now some ways to sound more precise.

**More and less.** Add **बढी** 'more' or **कम** 'less' for things you like or do: मलाई क्रिकेटभन्दा फुटबल **बढी** मन पर्छ 'I like football more than cricket'; ऊ मभन्दा **कम** खान्छ 'he eats less than me'.

**Actually Y is better.** Add **त** after the भन्दा-word and **नै** after the winner: नयाँ गीतभन्दा **त** पुराना गीत **नै** राम्रा छन् 'actually, the old songs are better than the new ones'. This is how you push back in an argument.

**As … as / not as … as.** **-जत्तिकै** 'just as': ऊ उसको दाइजत्तिकै राम्रो गाउँछ 'he sings as well as his brother'. Negative uses **-जत्तिको** + छैन: यो फिल्म किताबजत्तिको राम्रो **छैन** 'the film isn't as good as the book'.

**The same.** **उस्तै** 'the same, alike' — doubled for 'all the same': सबै एक्सन फिल्म **उस्तै-उस्तै** हुन्छन्.

**Rather than doing X, Y.** Put the first verb in the **-नु** form + **भन्दा**, and add **बरु** 'rather, instead' before the choice you prefer:
बाहिर **जानुभन्दा बरु** घरमै फिल्म हेरौँ — 'Rather than going out, let's watch a film at home.'
बरु on its own means 'instead, I'd rather': म **बरु** भोलि जान्छु 'I'd rather go tomorrow'.

examples.native: मलाई क्रिकेटभन्दा फुटबल बढी मन पर्छ।
examples.roman: malāi krikeṭbhandā phuṭbal baḍhi man parchha.
examples.en: I like football more than cricket.

examples.en: Actually, the Nepali film was better than the Hindi one.

examples.roman: ṭikaṭ kinna lāinmā basnubhandā baru anlāin buk garauṃ.
examples.en: Rather than queueing for tickets, let's book online.

grammar.title: The best, one of the best, better and better
grammar.body:
**The best.** **सबैभन्दा** + adjective (unit 8): सबैभन्दा राम्रो खेलाडी 'the best player'.

**Out of / among.** **-मध्ये** narrows the group: सबै खेल**मध्ये** मलाई फुटबल सबैभन्दा मन पर्छ 'of all sports, I like football best'. With **एक** 'one' it gives 'one of the…': नेपालको सबैभन्दा राम्रा खेलाडी**मध्ये एक** 'one of Nepal's best players'. Note the adjective goes into the plural -आ form (राम्रा) because it describes a group of people.

**Even more.** **झन्** (or अझ) + adjective: यो **झन्** राम्रो छ 'this is even better'. Doubled, **झन्-झन्** means 'more and more, increasingly' and goes with **-दै** 'getting': नेपाली फिल्म **झन्-झन्** राम्रो **हुँदै छन्** 'Nepali films are getting better and better'. झन् often adds a sense of 'and on top of that': पानी पर्‍यो, **झन्** जाम भयो 'it rained, and then the traffic got even worse'.

**The worst.** There's no special word — just सबैभन्दा नराम्रो / सबैभन्दा बेकार.

examples.native: सबै खेलमध्ये मलाई क्रिकेट हेर्न सबैभन्दा मन पर्छ।
examples.roman: sabai khelmadhye malāi krikeṭ herna sabaibhandā man parchha.
examples.en: Of all sports, I like watching cricket best.

examples.native: उनी नेपालका सबैभन्दा राम्रा गायकमध्ये एक हुन्।
examples.roman: uni nepālkā sabaibhandā rāmrā gāyakmadhye ek hun.
examples.en: He's one of Nepal's best singers.

examples.native: यो सिरिजको अन्त्य झन् दामी छ।
examples.roman: yo sirijko antya jhan dāmi chha.
examples.en: The ending of this series is even better.

examples.native: हाम्रो टिम झन्-झन् राम्रो खेल्दै छ।
examples.roman: hāmro ṭim jhan-jhan rāmro kheldai chha.
examples.en: Our team is playing better and better.

examples.native: त्यो वर्षको सबैभन्दा बेकार फिल्म थियो।
examples.roman: tyo barsako sabaibhandā bekār philim thiyo.
examples.en: It was the worst film of the year.

grammar.title: The more…, the more…: जति … उति
grammar.body:
Nepali builds 'the more…, the more…' with a matching pair: **जति** 'as much as' in the first clause and **उति** (or **त्यति**) 'that much' in the second:

यो गीत **जति** सुन्यो, **उति** मन पर्छ — 'The more I listen to this song, the more I like it.'

**The verb in the जति-clause** is very often the simple past form (सुन्यो, हेर्‍यो, खायो) used in a general sense — 'however much one listens' — even when you're talking about habits or the future. The habitual (सुन्छु) is also fine.

**Adjectives** slot straight in: **जति चाँडो, उति राम्रो** 'the sooner the better'; **जति धेरै, उति रमाइलो** 'the more the merrier'.

The same जति also gives 'as much as you like': **जति पनि** खानुहोस् 'eat as much as you like', and 'about, roughly' after numbers (दस मिनेट जति, unit 11).

**The trap**: don't translate 'the more' with धेरै … धेरै. Nepali needs the जति … उति pair (you can add धेरै inside: **जति धेरै** अभ्यास गर्‍यो, **उति** सजिलो हुन्छ).

examples.native: यो सिरिज जति हेर्‍यो, उति रमाइलो हुँदै जान्छ।
examples.roman: yo sirij jati heryo, uti ramāilo hundai jānchha.
examples.en: The more you watch this series, the better it gets.

examples.native: जति धेरै खेल्यो, उति राम्रो खेलाडी बनिन्छ।
examples.roman: jati dherai khelyo, uti rāmro khelāḍi baninchha.
examples.en: The more you play, the better a player you become.

dialogue.title: Film or match?
dialogue.setting: Friday evening in Kathmandu. Prerana and Aayush are planning their Saturday (the weekend day in Nepal).

lines.speaker: Prerana
lines.native: भोलि के गर्ने? फिल्म हेर्न जाने हो?
lines.roman: bholi ke garne? philim herna jāne ho?
lines.en: What shall we do tomorrow? Go and see a film?

lines.speaker: Aayush
lines.native: भोलि त नेपालको म्याच छ नि! म त्यो छुटाउँदिनँ।
lines.roman: bholi ta nepālko myāch chha ni! ma tyo chhuṭāundinaṃ.
lines.en: Tomorrow's the Nepal match! I'm not missing that.

lines.speaker: Prerana
lines.native: फेरि क्रिकेट? तिमी त मभन्दा बढी क्रिकेटलाई माया गर्छौ।
lines.roman: pheri krikeṭ? timi ta mabhandā baḍhi krikeṭlāi māyā garchhau.
lines.en: Cricket again? You love cricket more than me.

lines.speaker: Aayush
lines.native: हाहा, त्यस्तो होइन। तर यो सिरिजको सबैभन्दा ठूलो म्याच हो।
lines.roman: hāhā, tyasto hoina. tara yo sirijko sabaibhandā ṭhulo myāch ho.
lines.en: Haha, it's not like that. But it's the biggest match of the series.

lines.speaker: Aayush
lines.native: दिउँसो एक बजे। फिल्म बेलुका हेरौँ न, दुवै भ्याइन्छ।
lines.roman: diuṃso ek baje. philim belukā herauṃ na, duwai bhyāinchha.
lines.en: One o'clock. Let's see the film in the evening — we can fit in both.

lines.speaker: Prerana
lines.native: ठीक छ। नयाँ नेपाली फिल्म आएको छ रे, त्यो हेरौँ?
lines.roman: ṭhik chha. nayāṃ nepāli philim āeko chha re, tyo herauṃ?
lines.en: OK. Apparently there's a new Nepali film out — shall we see that?

lines.speaker: Aayush
lines.native: खै, पहिलो भागजत्तिको राम्रो छैन रे। बरु हलिउडको एक्सन फिल्म हेरौँ न।
lines.roman: khai, pahilo bhāgjattiko rāmro chhaina re. baru haliuḍko ekshan philim herauṃ na.
lines.en: Hmm, they say it's not as good as the first one. Let's see a Hollywood action film instead.

lines.speaker: Prerana
lines.native: एक्सन फिल्म सबै उस्तै-उस्तै हुन्छन्। नेपाली फिल्म झन्-झन् राम्रो हुँदै छन् नि।
lines.roman: ekshan philim sabai ustai-ustai hunchhan. nepāli philim jhan-jhan rāmro hundai chhan ni.
lines.en: Action films are all the same. Nepali films keep getting better.

lines.speaker: Aayush
lines.native: हुन त हो। यसका गीत पनि दामी छन्।
lines.roman: hun ta ho. yaskā git pani dāmi chhan.
lines.en: Fair enough. Its songs are great, too.

lines.speaker: Prerana
lines.native: त्यही त! टिकट अहिल्यै अनलाइन बुक गरौँ, जति चाँडो उति राम्रो।
lines.roman: tyahi ta! ṭikaṭ ahilyai anlāin buk garauṃ, jati chāṃḍo uti rāmro.
lines.en: Exactly! Let's book the tickets online right now — the sooner the better.

lines.speaker: Aayush
lines.native: ल, तर नेपाल हार्‍यो भने मेरो मुड बिग्रन्छ है, पहिल्यै भनिदिएँ।
lines.roman: la, tara nepāl hāryo bhane mero muḍ bigranchha hai, pahilyai bhanidieṃ.
lines.en: OK, but if Nepal lose, my mood will be ruined — I'm warning you now.

lines.speaker: Prerana
lines.native: हार्दैन, जित्छ! तर जितेपछि बेलुकाभरि म्याचको कुरा मात्र नगर्नू है।
lines.roman: hārdaina, jitchha! tara jitepachhi belukābhari myāchko kurā mātra nagarnu hai.
lines.en: They won't lose, they'll win! But once they've won, don't talk about the match all evening, OK?

culture:
**Cricket** has exploded in Nepal: when the national team (nicknamed the **Rhinos**) plays at home, the TU ground in Kirtipur is packed and people climb onto the surrounding hills and roofs to watch; a win sends crowds into the streets. **Football** is the other big love — most young people support a European club, and Premier League or Champions League nights fill bars and hostels. Many play **futsal** with friends after work.

In cinemas (QFX and others), Nepali films now compete with Hindi and Hollywood ones, and friends argue about them happily. Music runs from **लोकगीत** (folk songs) and the improvised call-and-answer **दोहोरी** — sung live in Kathmandu's दोहोरी साँझ restaurants — to Nepali rock, pop and rap. Everyone knows a few classic songs to sing on a picnic or a bus ride, with someone on a मादल drum.

For reviews, young people use English loanwords and slang freely: **दामी**, **बेकार**, **ओके-ओके** 'so-so', **बोर** 'boring', **हिट**. To older people you'd say **राम्रो छ** or **त्यति राम्रो लागेन** 'I didn't really like it' instead. And 'What do you do in your free time?' — **फुर्सदमा के गर्छौ?** — is a standard getting-to-know-you question.

tip.title: Reviewing like a local
tip.body:
- Great: **दामी छ!** (slang) · **एकदम राम्रो** · must-see: **हेर्नैपर्छ**.
- So-so: **ठिकै छ** · Terrible: **बेकार**, पैसा **खेर गयो**.
- 'Worth …-ing': verb-न + **लायक**: **हेर्नलायक**, खानलायक.
- Surprise verdict with रहेछ: बेकार **रहेछ** 'turned out rubbish'.

lessons.title: Which is better?

tip.title: Better than, as good as, rather than
tip.body:
- More / less: Y-**भन्दा बढी / कम**.
- 'Actually Y is better': X-भन्दा **त** Y **नै** राम्रो.
- 'Not as … as': Y-**जत्तिको** … **छैन**; 'just as': Y-**जत्तिकै**.
- 'Rather than doing X': X-**नुभन्दा बरु** Y.

tip.title: The best, one of the best, more and more
tip.body:
- Among: **-मध्ये**: सबै खेल**मध्ये** फुटबल सबैभन्दा मन पर्छ.
- 'One of the best': सबैभन्दा राम्रा खेलाडी**मध्ये एक**.
- Even more: **झन्** राम्रो. More and more: **झन्-झन्** + -दै छ.
- Supporting a team: X-को **फ्यान** हुँ.

sentences.native: मलाई सबै खेलमध्ये फुटबल सबैभन्दा मन पर्छ।
sentences.roman: malāi sabai khelmadhye phuṭbal sabaibhandā man parchha.
sentences.en: Of all sports, I like football best.

sentences.native: ऊ टिमको सबैभन्दा राम्रो खेलाडी हो।
sentences.roman: u ṭimko sabaibhandā rāmro khelāḍi ho.
sentences.en: He's the best player in the team.

sentences.native: उनी नेपालका सबैभन्दा राम्रा खेलाडीमध्ये एक हुन्।
sentences.roman: uni nepālkā sabaibhandā rāmrā khelāḍimadhye ek hun.
sentences.en: He's one of Nepal's best players.

sentences.native: हाम्रो क्रिकेट टिम झन्-झन् राम्रो हुँदै छ।
sentences.roman: hāmro krikeṭ ṭim jhan-jhan rāmro hundai chha.
sentences.en: Our cricket team is getting better and better.

sentences.native: हिजोको म्याच यो सिरिजको सबैभन्दा रमाइलो म्याच थियो।
sentences.roman: hijoko myāch yo sirijko sabaibhandā ramāilo myāch thiyo.
sentences.en: Yesterday's match was the most exciting of the series.

sentences.native: पानी पर्‍यो, झन् म्याच रोकियो।
sentences.roman: pāni paryo, jhan myāch rokiyo.
sentences.en: It rained, and on top of that the match was stopped.

sentences.native: म्याच कति बजे सुरु हुन्छ, सात बजे कि आठ?
sentences.roman: myāch kati baje suru hunchha, sāt baje ki āṭh?
sentences.en: What time does the match start, seven or eight?

sentences.native: म बार्सिलोनाको फ्यान हुँ, तिमी कुन टिमको फ्यान हौ?
sentences.roman: ma Bārsilonāko phyān huṃ, timi kun ṭimko phyān hau?
sentences.en: I'm a Barcelona fan — which team do you support?

sentences.native: आज साथीहरूसँग क्रिकेट खेल्ने प्लान छ।
sentences.roman: āja sāthiharusaṃga krikeṭ khelne plān chha.
sentences.en: Today I'm planning to play cricket with friends.

sentences.native: नेपालले नेदरल्यान्ड्सलाई हरायो!
sentences.roman: nepālle Nedaralyānḍslāi harāyo!
sentences.en: Nepal beat the Netherlands!

sentences.native: अहिले कति-कति भयो? दुई-एक।
sentences.roman: ahile kati-kati bhayo? dui-ek.
sentences.en: What's the score now? Two–one.

sentences.native: मेस्सीले आज कति गोल गर्‍यो?
sentences.roman: Messile āja kati gol garyo?
sentences.en: How many goals did Messi score today?

sentences.native: अन्त्यमा गोल भयो र खेल बराबरीमा सकियो।
sentences.roman: antyamā gol bhayo ra khel barābarimā sakiyo.
sentences.en: There was a goal at the very end and the game finished as a draw.

sentences.native: आज कसले जित्ला?
sentences.roman: āja kasle jitlā?
sentences.en: Who'll win today, do you think?

sentences.native: हाम्रो टिमले जित्छ भन्ने पक्का थियो।
sentences.roman: hāmro ṭimle jitchha bhanne pakkā thiyo.
sentences.en: I was sure our team would win.

sentences.native: जितेपछि सबै जना सडकमा निस्किए।
sentences.roman: jitepachhi sabai janā saḍakmā niskie.
sentences.en: After the win, everyone poured out into the streets.

sentences.native: खेल बराबरी भयो, कसैले जितेन।
sentences.roman: khel barābari bhayo, kasaile jitena.
sentences.en: It was a draw — nobody won.

lessons.title: What do you do for fun?

tip.title: The more…, the more…: जति … उति
tip.body:
- First clause **जति**, second clause **उति**: गीत **जति** सुन्यो, **उति** मन पर्छ.
- The जति-verb is often the past form used generally: सुन्यो, खेल्यो, बजायो.
- With adjectives: **जति चाँडो, उति राम्रो** 'the sooner the better'.
- Hobbies: मलाई … गर्ने **सोख** छ.

new: यो गीत जति सुन्यो, उति मन पर्छ।

sentences.native: गितार जति बजायो, उति सजिलो हुन्छ।
sentences.roman: gitār jati bajāyo, uti sajilo hunchha.
sentences.en: The more you play the guitar, the easier it gets.

sentences.native: जति धेरै पौडी खेल्यो, उति भोक लाग्छ।
sentences.roman: jati dherai pauḍi khelyo, uti bhok lāgchha.
sentences.en: The more you swim, the hungrier you get.

sentences.native: कन्सर्टमा जति ढिलो भयो, उति भिड बढ्यो।
sentences.roman: kansarṭmā jati ḍhilo bhayo, uti bhiḍ baḍhyo.
sentences.en: The later it got at the concert, the bigger the crowd became.

sentences.native: फुर्सदमा म गितार बजाउँछु र गीत गाउँछु।
sentences.roman: phursadmā ma gitār bajāunchhu ra git gāunchhu.
sentences.en: In my free time I play the guitar and sing.

sentences.native: मलाई नाच्ने सोख छ, तर नाच्न आउँदैन।
sentences.roman: malāi nāchne sokh chha, tara nāchna āundaina.
sentences.en: I love dancing, but I can't dance.

sentences.native: शनिबार नेपथ्यको कन्सर्ट छ, जाने?
sentences.roman: sanibār Nepathyako kansarṭ chha, jāne?
sentences.en: Nepathya are playing on Saturday — want to go?

sentences.native: तिमीलाई पौडी खेल्न आउँछ?
sentences.roman: timilāi pauḍi khelna āunchha?
sentences.en: Can you swim?

sentences.native: यो गीत जति सुन्यो, उति नाच्न मन लाग्छ।
sentences.roman: yo git jati sunyo, uti nāchna man lāgchha.
sentences.en: The more I listen to this song, the more I want to dance.

sentences.native: जति धेरै साथी आए, उति रमाइलो हुन्छ।
sentences.roman: jati dherai sāthi āe, uti ramāilo hunchha.
sentences.en: The more friends come, the more fun it is.
